authoritative.pr_545: MATCHUP_RESPONSE sweep — BROADER MODEL RECALIBRATION REQUIRED

qb_layer.v1_reconstruction: Layer A talent + class + portal. Cast held at 50 so cast_mult = 1.0. Recruiting / Layer B missing.

compose.v1_reconstruction: Roster / units / coaching are league-average fills (50 / returning). Efficiency is prior-year cfb_ratings, not live SP+.

expected_team_points.response: MATCHUP_RESPONSE * EARLY_SEASON_SEPARATION_SOFTEN[week] for W1–W4; else MATCHUP_RESPONSE
expected_team_points.unit_offense_boost: clamp(1 + UNIT_OFFENSE_BOOST_SCALE * signed(OL, skill), 0.85, 1.15)  — identity 1.0 when units=50
expected_team_points.unit_defense_dampen: clamp(1 - UNIT_DEFENSE_DAMPEN_SCALE * signed(F7, secondary), 0.82, 1.18)  — identity 1.0 when units=50
additive: week-decayed coaching adj (0 on this reconstruction)

game_total.expected_total: home_points + away_points + st_nudge  (nudge split evenly across both scores)

terms_that_can_move_the_total: unit offense boost / defense dampen (identity on v1)
variable HFA (additive to home, therefore to total)
QB talent / class / cast (via compose + QB_INDEX_BLEND)
totals_equation.why_140_can_need_a_huge_downward_respons: If E[offense_index] > E[defense_index], then E[ratio] > 1 on both sides of a typical game. ratio**1.40 is convex for ratio>1, so the upper tail explodes and both team scores rise. Lowering r shrinks that convexity but cannot fix a systematic O>D location or a double-counted QB/efficiency lever.

ranked.label: multiplicative matchup interaction
ranked.hypothesis: ratio**response is the remaining location engine. Identity matchup isolates baseline + additive terms.

ranked.label: QB talent response/scale
ranked.hypothesis: Layer A talent + class + QB_INDEX_BLEND raise offense indices above the hist-cal placeholder@50 path.

ranked.label: offensive/defensive strength centering
ranked.hypothesis: Offense indices sit above 1.0 and/or defense below 1.0, so off/def > 1 on both sides and totals inflate even at r=0.70.

ranked.label: duplicated / double-counted strength effects
ranked.hypothesis: QB and efficiency enter the weighted score and again via post-compose index blends, then again through off/def.

ranked.label: home-field contribution
ranked.hypothesis: Variable HFA adds ~1–3 points to every non-neutral total.

ranked.label: baseline scoring / efficiency PPG level
ranked.hypothesis: Prior-year off_eff/def_eff are not centered at 50, so compose starts above league average before matchup is applied.

ranked.label: nonlinear/exponent interaction
ranked.hypothesis: ratio**r (r=1.40) explodes the upper tail versus a linear response of the same coefficient.

ranked.label: clipping/floors/ceilings
ranked.hypothesis: EXPECTED_POINTS_CLAMP (7, 55) and ratio soft-clamp distort location or the upper tail.

ranked.label: supporting-cast contribution
ranked.hypothesis: Cast is already held at 50 on this universe; neutralizing it again should be a near-zero move.

decision.evidence_required_to_open_parameters: ≥3 material families, or centering AND QB both ≥1.0 bias-move @1.40, or matchup identity AND remaining centering @0.70. Fit jointly on Train-0 with Val-0/Val-1 holdout. Still no 2025.
do_not: Do not open PLAY or Line Curve.

reconstruction_limits: Score-time overlays only. Production MATCHUP_RESPONSE remains 1.40.
0.70 is the authorized floor from PR #545, not an earned coefficient.
One family at a time. No joint optimization.
Layer A QB only. Layer B cast/recruiting held out at 50.
Roster / units / coaching are league-average fills.
2025 sealed. 2026 excluded. Actual outcomes are the objective.
